description: Connect for reporting when your app has not signed in to Truvon itself: a link your user approves with one tap (no account), and a connection code the reporting tools then accept as their connection argument. Searching needs none of this.

client.description: Your assistant or product name, for Truvon's own records (optional; never shown to the person)

name: connect_truvon

connection.description: The connection code (tvia_…), the reporting tools' connection argument once your user has approved

expires_in.description: How many seconds the link stays good

link.description: The link for your user to open and approve with one tap (good for 24 hours)

title: Connect for reporting
